title: Larkspur Tasks: mobile app design system, screens, prototype and developer handoff
deliverable: One native design file holding a themed design system (Light and Dark), a Button component set and four more component families, four auto-layout mobile screens plus one tablet layout, a clickable prototype with an overlay and smart animate, and a developer handoff: ready-for-dev sections, annotations, measurements, per-frame and icon exports, token files and code snippets.
input_assets: None proprietary. All artwork is drawn in the file; the product and its copy are fictional.
Font: Inter from hsk-studio-harness/tests/fixtures (OFL, license file beside it)

Bridge fixture for what only works from import: hsk-studio-interop-fig/tests/fixtures/fig-components-autolayout.fig (Operator-authored per the crate descriptor). It is used to exercise callable steps only and is not part of the deliverable.
workspace_or_layout_preset: vector default Layout Preset (STU-SHL-086, line 32223) as the closest shipped profile; the spec defines no design-system preset, and STU-DS-160 and STU-WEB-031 forbid a persona toggle. Task Scope export_slices (STU-SHL-153) for the asset export step.

evidence_basis.tree: origin tip c4d06841, read via git grep and git show from worktree wt-studio-lanes/smb-type-authored-token-1; not checked out, nothing built or run

command_id_prefixes.viewer_api:: a public Rust method of the harness Viewer or PrototypePlay; callable from a Rust host or test, NOT from the CLI, no command id
command_id_prefixes.crate_api:: a public crate function with no host reaching it
command_id_prefixes.spec:: name the spec requires; not bound in code

evidence_basis.harness_drive_note: SMB-HARNESS-DRIVE-1 (state, command, undo, JSONL) is not at this tip: cli.rs dispatch at lines 270-416 has help, descriptors, providers, open, panel, edit, verify, import, export, develop, export-sequence, batch, action. If it lands with RUN_COMMANDS ids only, the viewer_api steps here still have no command id.
evidence_basis.workflow_sources_note: Search result summaries were read, not the full pages; the step order is the author's professional reading and is UNVERIFIED against any single vendor tutorial. No vendor text, asset or source copied.

runner_notes.execution_order: Steps run in order. A missing step stops its dependants; the runner records blocked rather than skipping silently. Steps listed in coverage.callable_steps_needing_a_predecessor_that_is_missing must run against the bridge document and be labelled as such.
